goal: Analyze the competitive landscape of NVIDIA in the AI accelerator market

report.executive_summary: NVIDIA holds a dominant position in the AI accelerator market with an estimated 80-90% market share by revenue in 2025, but its share is expected to decline to 75% by 2026 as competitors like AMD and custom ASICs gain traction.

competitors.name: AMD
competitors.summary: AMD is a direct competitor to NVIDIA in the AI accelerator market with its Instinct series gaining traction.

competitors.name: Groq
competitors.summary: Groq is a competitor that has a licensing agreement with NVIDIA and is expected to release LPX racks in 2026.

competitors.name: Broadcom and Marvell
competitors.summary: These companies are gaining ground in custom AI accelerators (ASICs), which are expected to capture 37% of data center inference deployments.

recent_developments.text: NVIDIA unveiled the Vera Rubin platform at CES 2026, which is expected to be a six-chip platform.
NVIDIA's market share in AI accelerators is projected to decrease to 75% by 2026 as custom ASICs and AMD's Instinct series gain traction.

market_signals.text: The AI accelerators market is expected to grow at a CAGR of 24.29% from 2025 to 2031.
Cloud/data-center deployments captured 75% of the AI accelerators market share in 2024, with edge/on-device solutions advancing at a 27% CAGR.

risks.text: NVIDIA's market share is expected to decline as custom ASICs and competitors like AMD and Groq gain traction.
The expansion of the AI accelerators market may lead to increased competition and potential erosion of NVIDIA's dominance.
